items.title: Camara is confirmed for Abu Dhabi as Haas completes its 2026 line-up
items.summary: Haas confirmed Rafael Camara for its final two 2026 Grands Prix, Qatar and Abu Dhabi, after his Brazil and Las Vegas outings. Camara says he will miss the final two Formula 2 rounds to continue with Haas; the team also confirmed Oliver Bearman for 2027, completing next year’s F1 grid.
items.why_it_matters: Camara is a confirmed Abu Dhabi race driver, not merely a possible practice substitute. Keep the 2026 race seat, his F2 title challenge, and the 2027 Haas pairing distinct.

items.title: Hamilton holds a narrow pre-Qatar advantage in the fight for third
items.summary: The official Formula1.com tables checked on 28 November, before the Qatar race, list Lewis Hamilton on 267 points, three ahead of George Russell and Lando Norris tied on 264; Charles Leclerc has 250. Red Bull are third in the Teams’ standings on 440, nine ahead of McLaren on 431. These are pre-Qatar totals, not Abu Dhabi entering-round snapshots.
items.why_it_matters: The Qatar Grand Prix can change the remaining-position battles before the finale. Refresh the standings after Qatar and do not carry these pre-race totals into Abu Dhabi coverage.
